segments.text: I want to start with Taylor.
Thanks so much for the nice words.
You know, you've been a player who I always looked up to
for your consistency.
You know, you've been at the top level
for such an incredible amount of time
and I know you are still running for the finals
and as I said on the net,
I wish you really the best to reach it even this year
and I want to say congrats to your team
because I know you guys are doing an incredible job.
so keep doing like this.
Thank you.
Thank you so much.
I want to say thanks to my team.
Gianluca and Federico, it's been an incredible week.
Thank you to Gianluca and Federico, it's been super.
And especially with Gianluca, it's our first week together.
I think it started pretty well.
We were joking about this at the beginning of when we were leaving for Lyon,
to try to go until Sunday, and here we are.
so I, let's say, all the bets were against us,
but we overruled the bets during the journey
of this tournament, who was really a rollercoaster
of emotion, so I'm really, really happy
for the work that we have done.
Thank you.
Thank you very much.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
I want to say also thanks to the team who is not here this week, who is behind the
scene, who is already in Vienna preparing the next tournament, so I know I was feeling
the support even from there.
And of course I want to say really thanks to Thierry and Joe and who made it possible
because I think I totally agree with what Taylor said.
It's rare to see such a beautiful venue and such a beautiful center core and such an atmosphere like today, even the past days for a 250.
So I really, really appreciate it and hopefully I'll come back in the next years.
I want to say thanks to all the medical staff that were behind this.
and the physio from ATP, from the tournament,
because they've done an incredible job with me.
Finished pretty late, the quarter finals.
Yesterday was really a tough match,
and honestly, I felt completely dead after those matches,
but I don't know how, I don't know in what way
when I stepped on the court,
I felt the energy from the crowd
and from all the nice work that they've done,
So I really appreciated the work and effort
by all the medical staff and the physio from the tournament.
And last but not least, I want to say thanks to Gianluca's daughter who
gave me this necklace as a lucky charm, and I think it worked out really well, so I want to dedicate this trophy to Vittorio, my niece.
